title: Used-car inspection
notConnected: Connect to the car (or the simulator) to run an inspection.
subtitle: Screens the engine/emissions ECU — not a mechanical check.

pass.title: Used-car check passed ({{score}}/100)
pass.detail: The engine / emissions ECU shows nothing suspicious: no stored codes and no sign of a recent code clear. It screens the ECU only, not the mechanics or the body.

caution.title: Used-car check: caution ({{score}}/100)
caution.detail: Pending codes, a possible recent code clear or reset in-use counters were found. Re-check after a full drive cycle before you decide.

fail.title: Used-car check failed ({{score}}/100)
fail.detail: The check-engine light is on or stored / permanent fault codes are present: a current fault needs a diagnosis before you buy or sell.
